CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFCOLLECTION

CFCOLLECTION manages Verity collections, the full-text indexes that CFINDEX fills and CFSEARCH queries. It does from a template what the Verity page of the KoldFusion Administrator does by hand, which is handy for setup scripts and for applications that build their own indexes.

Category

Verity search

Syntax

<CFCOLLECTION ACTION="action"
    COLLECTION="collection_name"
    PATH="directory"
    LANGUAGE="English">

Attributes

ACTION
Required. One of CREATE, MAP, REPAIR, OPTIMIZE or DELETE. See Usage.
COLLECTION
Required. Name of the collection. Letters, digits, underscores and hyphens only.
PATH
Optional; required for MAP. For CREATE, the directory in which the collection's own folder is made. The default is the verity/collections directory of the KoldFusion installation. For MAP, the directory that already holds the collection folder.
LANGUAGE
Optional, default "English". Recorded with the collection and shown in the Administrator. KoldFusion's search engine treats every collection the same way, so the setting is informational.

Usage

  • CREATE makes a new, empty collection and registers it with the server. It throws an error if a collection of that name already exists.
  • MAP registers a collection that already exists on disk (for example one copied from another server) under the given name. Nothing is checked or copied.
  • REPAIR and OPTIMIZE both rewrite the collection file, dropping documents that were deleted. On a KoldFusion-sized collection this takes a blink, not the coffee break Verity needed in 1999.
  • DELETE removes the collection's files and its registration. There is no undo.

Collections are registered under Verity\Collections in the server registry and listed on the Verity page of the Administrator. There is no ACTION="LIST" in 4.5; use the Administrator to see what exists. Errors (unknown collection, duplicate name, bad characters) throw an exception you can catch with CFTRY.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- A throwaway collection: create it, fill it, search it, delete it --->
<CFSET CollName = "snippets_temp">

<!--- tidy up after an interrupted earlier run --->
<CFTRY>
  <CFCOLLECTION ACTION="DELETE" COLLECTION="#CollName#">
<CFCATCH TYPE="Any"></CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>

<CFCOLLECTION ACTION="CREATE" COLLECTION="#CollName#">
<CFINDEX COLLECTION="#CollName#" ACTION="UPDATE" TYPE="PATH"
    KEY="#ExpandPath('/CFDOCS/langref/')#" EXTENSIONS=".htm"
    URLPATH="/CFDOCS/langref">
<CFCOLLECTION ACTION="OPTIMIZE" COLLECTION="#CollName#">
<CFSEARCH NAME="Hits" COLLECTION="#CollName#" CRITERIA="collection" MAXROWS="5">
<CFCOLLECTION ACTION="DELETE" COLLECTION="#CollName#">

<CFOUTPUT>
<H3>Collection #CollName#: created, indexed, searched and deleted</H3>
<P>Language Reference pages that mention "collection" (#Hits.RecordCount# shown):
</CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Score</TH><TH>Page</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Hits">
<TR><TD>#Score#</TD><TD><A HREF="#Hits.URL#">#Title#</A></TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
